set.prevailing_wage_basis: No program rule found. The HCD HHAP Round 6 amended NOFA (95 pages, also governing HHAP 7 disbursements) and the County 2027 Action Plan NOFA HHAP section contain no prevailing wage or Labor Code requirement; the County NOFA cites Davis-Bacon only for HOME (12+ HOME units, 24 CFR 92.354) and CDBG. Any obligation on HHAP capital for permanent housing would rest on the general Labor Code 1720(b) public-funds definition and depends on 1720(c) exemptions and project facts.
set.audit_note: Tier 3: prevailing wage left unclear; HHAP statute and NOFA state no rule, coverage of HHAP-funded capital depends on Labor Code 1720(b) and 1720(c) project facts. Services, interim operations and rental subsidy uses are not construction.

reason: Neither the HCD HHAP 6 amended NOFA nor the County 2027 Action Plan NOFA states a prevailing wage rule for HHAP, and HSC statute text on california.public.law returned 403.
